No sweep; the cut follows the live prices online either way. spec: a drafted request's ms a token, its whole wall time without the head's backlog (1k 56.5, 32k 53.0, 140k 50.7, 260,800 39.4 tok/s on those runs); prime: the head's ms a backlog row (0.055 at 32k, 0.28 at 260,800 measured; 0 and 131072 estimated between).
